# Operator scientific assumptions

## Conserved mixture and relaxation

An instance has two terminal crystalline phases at compositions 0 and 1, plus
zero, one, or two intermediate fixed-composition phases. Their synthetic free
energies are sampled on a strictly convex negative quadratic. Thus all generated
phases lie on the lower envelope. At a composition between adjacent phases,
linear interpolation gives the energy-minimizing nonnegative fractions. The
implementation is independently checked against constrained linear programming.
These are formula-unit fractions; unequal scattering strengths are included.
No finite-width solid solutions, pressure or temperature variation are modeled.

The equilibrium population `q` has total mass one and B composition `x`.
`powder_blend` starts with terminal fractions `1-x,x`; `quenched` starts with an
amorphous reservoir of composition x. A shared residual fraction
`r(t)=(1-w) exp(-k_fast(x)t)+w exp(-k_slow(x)t)` interpolates from that preparation
to q. This is a positive two-mode relaxation model, equivalent to independent
first-order conversion of two preparation subpopulations. It preserves mass and
composition at every time. It is not a nucleation, diffusion, or realistic
multiphase reaction model. Nonzero residual at the maximum hold is retained.
All hidden rates are fixed for an instance. Finite-time observations never
certify the asymptotic thermodynamic limit.

## Observation and nuisances

Each crystalline phase contributes five Gaussian spectral peaks with fixed
amplitudes, centers and widths; overlapping peaks are allowed. The quenched
reservoir contributes two broad composition-dependent humps. Intensities add
linearly by phase fraction and sample loading. A fixed smooth baseline and two
weak holder peaks add independently of loading. Those holder peaks are an
apparatus nuisance, not resampled contamination or a material phase. There is
no peak cutoff; weak features remain in the continuous vector and may be below
measurement noise. Angle sampling evaluates the same analytic spectrum exactly,
so changing grid density has no physical effect.

Independent additive zero-mean Gaussian noise of sigma 0.003 is generated by a
stable hash of instance, canonical spec and externally supplied noise key.
Distinct externally allocated keys represent independent replicates. There is
no process noise, clipping, unknown variance, or shared random synthesis state.
No phase labels, populations, noise keys, or clean targets enter public responses.

## Evidence and exposure

Three operator strata differ by the count of intermediate phases. These labels
are not accepted discovery answers or disclosed to the candidate. The default
selector samples strata; balance is an explicit operator campaign decision.
Development uses the prespecified seeds 71,72,73. Future cohorts must exclude
those exposed instances and freeze fresh seeds independently. Randomized
parameters and unseen seeds alone do not establish contamination resistance.
The apparatus does not establish unique microscopic structures from finite
spectra, and this development does not calibrate Agent difficulty or scaling.
